summary: Computes a derived value from a2 via ShortComputation_0b10 and copies it through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, then extracts the directory portion of a path string: the first string of this (falling back to the default buffer byte_5EA438 when null) is truncated at its last backslash (0x5C / 92) by zeroing trailing characters. Finally the first global function-pointer slot off_5C3F9C[0] is passed to sub_5665B0 for path processing.

operations.description: ShortComputation_0b10(a2) computes a derived value from the a2 argument and stores it into v3.
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(v3) copies the computed string into a destination with automatic buffer reallocation.
Load the first string pointer of this; when this[0] is null, fall back to the default buffer byte_5EA438.
Compute the path length v5 = strlen(v4) + 1; if (v5 - 1) > 0 the truncation loop runs.
Walk backward from &v4[v5 - 2] to v4, zeroing each character until a backslash byte (92 / 0x5C) is found, which strips the filename and leaves the directory part.
sub_5665B0(off_5C3F9C[0]) processes the (now directory-only) path via the first entry of the global function-pointer/table at off_5C3F9C.

unresolved: off_5C3F9C is a global table/function-pointer array; only slot [0] is consumed here and its meaning is external to this packet.
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc returns a buffer pointer whose value is ignored by this function (only the side effect of the copy is relied upon).
Exact semantics of ShortComputation_0b10(a2) and sub_5665B0 are defined by their own functions, not this packet.
